# Scope for Linux

> Scope for Linux (also called Scope) is a free, open-source app manager. It lists apps, command-line tools and games from APT, Snap, Flatpak, AppImage, uv, pipx, Cargo, npm, Bun, Steam and JetBrains Toolbox in one searchable list, and it shows the exact commands for every update or uninstall before anything runs. Written in Rust with Zed's GPUI. Ubuntu on x86-64 is the primary target. Version 0.3.8, MIT License.

Scope is a desktop app for Ubuntu and other Linux systems. It answers the question "what is installed on this machine, and how do I update or remove it safely?" Admin actions use the standard Polkit dialog, so the app never sees the user's password.

## Pages

- [Home](https://khurrambhutto.github.io/scope/): What Scope is, how a change works, supported sources, install, and FAQ.
- [Install](https://khurrambhutto.github.io/scope/install.html): Install the .deb on Ubuntu, run the AppImage, install apps from downloaded files, build from source, and remove Scope.
- [Safety](https://khurrambhutto.github.io/scope/safety.html): How previews, revalidation, APT simulation, the deny-list, and Trash protect the user.
- [Full text](https://khurrambhutto.github.io/scope/llms-full.txt): Everything above in one Markdown file, for AI tools that read a single document.

## Code and releases

- [Source code](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/scope): Rust source, README, architecture notes in AGENTS.md.
- [Releases](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/scope/releases): .deb and AppImage packages with signed checksum manifests.
- [Issues](https://github.com/khurrambhutto/scope/issues): Bug reports and feature requests.

## Facts

- Name: Scope for Linux (short name: Scope)
- Category: Linux desktop app manager, package manager front end
- Platform: Linux, Ubuntu first, x86-64
- Update and uninstall: APT, Snap, Flatpak, uv tools, pipx, Cargo, npm global, Bun global, and AppImages in ~/AppImages installed by Scope or Gear Lever
- Discovery only: other AppImages and unmanaged desktop launchers
- Read-only: Steam games (open in Steam) and JetBrains Toolbox IDEs (open Toolbox)
- Installs downloaded .deb files and AppImages with a preview (Open With → Scope)
- Stack: Rust, Zed's GPUI, no webview
- License: MIT
- Author: Khurram Bhutto (https://github.com/khurrambhutto)
- Current release: v0.3.8 (https://github.com/khurrambhutto/scope/releases/tag/v0.3.8)
